_comment: MCP configurations for wikicitation-mcp (pure Python, no R required)
_instructions: Choose the section matching your surface and copy it to the appropriate file.

claude_code._how_to: Run from the wikicitation-mcp/ folder: claude mcp add wikicitation -- uv run python server.py   (or: claude mcp add wikicitation -- uvx wikicitation-mcp)

claude_desktop._how_to: Copy the 'mcpServers' block into the file above and restart Claude Desktop.

_how_to: 1. Start HTTP server: uv run python server.py --transport streamable-http --port 8000
2. Open claude.ai -> Settings -> Connections -> Add MCP server
Note: for remote access, expose the server via a tunnel (ngrok, Cloudflare Tunnel, etc.)

optional_env.CROSSREF_MAILTO: your e-mail, for CrossRef's polite pool
